trivia: Prior to 'Enter SM64', agent z 100%'d their save file on Super Mario 64 from Super Mario 3D All-Stars. Before, it had just been completed at 70 stars.
As of 'Cooking Together', G was standardised to be x10 the USD value of any given item. Example: $5.00USD would be 50G.
The 'About agent z' section was intended to be a replacement for the 'Agent Z Wiki' that allowed for more freedom over its appearance.
The Power Trip Story Arc spanned 1 year and 20 days, 55 weeks, or 386 days from September 10th 2023 to September 30th 2024.
2026 was the first year to not start with a Splatshort compilation (excluding 2023) due to a compilation already having been made in November 2025.
While titled similarly, 'agent z Versus' is not an intentional reference to 'Nintendo Versus', official branding for Nintendo's competitive tournaments.
The brand Agent 3 tries to order food from in 'Cooking Together', 'DashEats', is a reference to 'Door Dash' and 'Uber Eats' in the real world.
agent z had sent 15 messages in the agent z Art Contest Discord Server prior to its initial opening. They mainly comprised of server rules and screenshots of the next episode.
Neo Agent 3's jacket's collar very frequently clips with the inside of her mouth. It can be seen particularly when her mouth does inhumane stretches.
Background characters, as well as Agent Z and X themselves use the same type of phone in videos.
The agent z official icon was redesigned after the first episode of 2026 released, giving it smoother edges and being more in HD.

Bonus: flattered that you're interested enough to go looking in the code (:
